decisions.target: small business owners with a Cobalt card reader

actions.action: Debit card cash back for 4 weeks
Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers
Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 1%, up to $5 cash back. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 3 (small business owners with a Cobalt card reader).
Actions: Debit card cash back for 4 weeks, Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers, Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently.
Cost $2,200,000 of the $4M budget.

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks
Free instant transfers to other banks

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 2 weeks. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 1 (students).
Actions: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks, Free instant transfers to other banks, Offline card limit during migration $100 -> $250.
Cost $1,000,000 of the $4M budget.
